default.notes: A visa is required — apply through the Serbian embassy or consulate serving your place of residence before travel.

groups.notes: Visa-free for up to 90 days in any 180-day period.
Visa-free for up to 30 days per visit under a bilateral agreement.

RS.notes: Home country — no entry requirements for Serbian citizens.

XK.notes: Serbia does not recognise Kosovo passports, so they cannot be used at Serbian borders. Kosovo residents instead cross under a special regime using Kosovo ID cards at designated crossings; travel on a Kosovo passport requires arrangements through a Serbian mission and is effectively impractical.

HK.notes: Holders of Hong Kong SAR passports are commonly listed as visa-free for a short stay of up to 14 days — confirm with the Serbian MFA before travel.
